column1: # Local subscribed source 3782099990, numeric version 1. No Lua is bundled.
Adds subtle per-material colors to natural stone floors in graphics mode. Includes a DFHack GUI with live tint-strength presets and rough/smooth floor toggles. Requires DFHack.
column2: 在图形模式下，按材质为天然石质地面添加淡淡的颜色。附带 DFHack 设置界面，可即时调整着色强度，并分别开关粗糙与平滑地面的着色。需要 DFHack。

column1: Natural stone floors display subtle colors based on their actual material. Includes a live strength slider and rough/smooth floor controls. Requires DFHack 53.15-r3 or compatible. Open settings with the DFHack command: stone-tint
column2: 天然石质地面会按实际材质显示淡淡的颜色。提供即时生效的强度滑块与粗糙、平滑地面开关。需要 DFHack 53.15-r3 或兼容版本。设置命令：stone-tint。
